name: Ginsei Senshin Guynarock 2
original_name: 銀聖戦神ガイナロック 2
source:
2125. Half a year after the first incident. This time the SIS crew stumbles upon another ghost spaceship. Having found nothing, they move on, but two girls develop some body abnormalities. What kind of disease is brought from the abandoned spaceship?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-december-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2125年，第一起事件半年后。SIS队员这次偶然遇到了另一艘幽灵飞船。他们什么也没找到便继续前进，但其中两名女孩开始出现身体异常。被遗弃的飞船带来了什么疾病？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-december-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
